Hardswish activation: x \* relu6(x + 3) / 6.

Swish with its sigmoid replaced by a straight piece: 0 below -3, x above 3, x \* (x + 3) / 6 between. Cheap to compute; MobileNetV3 and EfficientNet-Lite use it. Same as torch.nn.Hardswish.

## Usage

```text
Conv2D -> BatchNorm -> Hardswish
```

```text
Cheaper than Swish and Mish, with nearly the same shape.
```

## Tips

- The activation of MobileNetV3 and EfficientNet-Lite.
- A good swap for ReLU in small CNNs.
